item.title: Implement MCP server for Immich REST API
item.justification: Expose Immich endpoints via MCP using the OpenAPI spec as the source of truth.

security-impact.notes: Handles API tokens/keys and remote API calls; ensure secrets are not logged and TLS is required.

tasks.task: Define configuration inputs (Immich base URL, API key/token)
Ingest the OpenAPI spec and map core endpoints to MCP tools
Add basic error handling and user-facing messages

manual-steps.step: Start the MCP server and list available tools
Invoke one read-only Immich endpoint and verify a successful response

r.observations: Added config-driven Immich HTTP handling, OpenAPI spec fetch, and core MCP tools (ping, server info/version, current user).
r.lessons-learned: Use the raw GitHub URL for JSON specs to avoid HTML responses.

item.title: Filter MCP tools by API key permissions
item.justification: Limit exposed MCP tools to actions permitted by the Immich API key or token to avoid authorization errors and reduce accidental misuse.

tasks.task: Identify Immich capability sources (user info, role, or permissions) and decide how to map them to tool access.
Add a capability discovery step in the MCP server startup or per-request path.
Filter tool exposure based on discovered capabilities and provide a clear user-facing reason when a tool is unavailable.
Document required permissions and how to validate them with the Immich API.

manual-steps.step: Start the MCP server with a read-only API key and confirm only read-safe tools are listed.
Start the MCP server with a full-access token and confirm all tools are listed.

affected-items.item-ref: Implement MCP server for Immich REST API

impact-check.notes: Item 1 has no completeness or test-coverage metadata; verify behavior manually after capability filtering is introduced.

r.observations: Added capability discovery and conditional tool registration; provided a tool access report for visibility into blocked tools.
r.lessons-learned: Capability checks should be cached to avoid repeated permission probes.

item.title: Add integration test using .env_test credentials
item.justification: Validate behavior with restricted read-only credentials and ensure tool exposure and calls align with allowed permissions.

tasks.task: Define an integration test harness that loads .env_test and targets a running Immich instance.
Add a test case that verifies restricted credentials only expose read-safe tools.
Add a test case that confirms privileged credentials expose additional tools.
Document how to run the integration test and required environment setup.

manual-steps.step: Run the integration tests with .env_test and confirm blocked tools are reported as unavailable.
Run the integration tests with full credentials and confirm all tools are available.

affected-items.item-ref: Implement MCP server for Immich REST API
Filter MCP tools by API key permissions

impact-check.notes: Items 1 and 2 have no completeness or test-coverage metadata; integration tests will reduce manual verification risk.

r.observations: Added integration tests that load env files and assert tool exposure matches Immich permission probes.
r.lessons-learned: Use unittest discovery for tests stored under the tests/ directory.

item.title: Update README to reflect current project usage and status
item.justification: Keep project documentation accurate so users can run and test the current MCP server and understand its status.

tasks.task: Review current README content against implemented features and tools.
Document current usage, configuration, and available tools.
Update test instructions to reflect integration tests and env files.

manual-steps.step: Review README to confirm it matches the implemented MCP tool set and configuration.

affected-items.item-ref: Implement MCP server for Immich REST API
Filter MCP tools by API key permissions

impact-check.notes: Items 1-3 lack completeness/test-coverage metadata; README updates should align with current behavior to avoid confusion.

r.observations: Updated README to list current tools, configuration, and integration test setup aligned with the implemented MCP server.
r.lessons-learned: Keeping a concise tool list in the README reduces confusion when permissions gate tool exposure.

item.title: Add Dockerfile and docker-compose for local usage
item.justification: Provide containerized setup for running the MCP server with consistent dependencies.

tasks.task: Create a Dockerfile that installs dependencies and runs the MCP server.
Add a docker-compose.yaml with environment configuration for Immich access.
Document container usage and required environment variables.

manual-steps.step: Build the container image and start it with docker-compose.
Verify the MCP server starts and can ping the Immich server.

affected-items.item-ref: Implement MCP server for Immich REST API

impact-check.notes: Item 1 lacks completeness/test-coverage metadata; container usage should be validated manually.

r.observations: Added Dockerfile, docker-compose configuration, and a .dockerignore to keep secrets out of images.
r.lessons-learned: Compose defaults for host networking simplify local Immich access on Windows.

Added feature item 3: Add integration test using .env_test credentials.
Items 3 implemented. Added integration tests for credential-based tool exposure and documentation.
Added refactor item 4: Update README to reflect current project usage and status.
Added feature item 5: Add Dockerfile and docker-compose for local usage.
Items 5 implemented. Added Dockerfile, docker-compose configuration, and documentation.
Items 4 implemented. Updated README with current usage, tools, and test guidance.
